title: Yonaguni language
extract: The Yonaguni language is a Southern Ryukyuan language spoken by around 400 people on the island of Yonaguni, in the Ryukyu Islands, the westernmost of the chain lying just east of Taiwan. It is most closely related to Yaeyama. Due to the Japanese policy on languages, the language is not recognized by the government, which instead calls it the Yonaguni dialect . As classified by UNESCO, the Yonaguni language is one of the most endangered languages in all of Japan, after the Ainu language.
